name: Risette Kesselrink
original_name: リゼット＝ケッセルリンク
source:
She is the best magician in the kingdom, born with a genius mind and powerful magical powers. 

She is characterized by her cold eyes and inorganic facial expression, and emits an aura that does not allow others to approach her. Her speech is stiff and she is not very good at expressing her emotions. 

She is always absorbed in her research and quietly explodes with passionate anger when disturbed. She is on a mission and sees life as somewhat ephemeral.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
